### The WCA is coming to Leeward Oahu with a special series competition!

##### This competition is in a series with [Nānākuli Li'i 'Okakopa A 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NanakuliLiiOkakopaA2026). You will only be able to compete in one of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
